verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a feature-flag and release-control SaaS, not an agent or AI client that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers in for it to use is outside its product role. The evidence documents only an official LaunchDarkly MCP server (local and hosted) that serves its own tools to other agents. That is server-side capability and does not make this MCP-client axis applicable.
